heroSummary: VBCPS students start school Monday, August 24, 2026, and the scheduled last day is Friday, June 11, 2027. Winter Break runs December 21 through January 1, with students returning Monday, January 4. The calendar uses four grading periods; June 11 is also a districtwide adjusted-dismissal day. If instructional days are missed because of weather or another emergency, the superintendent determines the make-up dates.

calendarNotes: VBCPS schedules 180 instructional days from August 24, 2026, through June 11, 2027. The year uses four grading periods ending October 30, January 22, April 8, and June 11. Only June 11 is identified as a districtwide adjusted-dismissal day, while June 8–10 are adjusted-dismissal days for high school students. Winter Break runs December 21 through January 1, and students return Monday, January 4. Labor Day creates a four-day weekend because schools are closed Friday, September 4, and Monday, September 7. November 2, January 25, and April 9 are student-free staff days and the designated make-up dates for the first three grading periods if VBCPS activates them. Any fourth-grading-period make-up date is designated by the superintendent.

whatsNew.title: What Changed From 2025–26
content: School starts one day earlier: August 24, 2026, compared with August 25 last year.
The scheduled last student day is one day earlier: June 11, 2027, compared with June 12 last year.
Spring Break moves earlier, from April 6–10 in 2025–26 to March 29–April 2 in 2026–27.
The three-weekday Thanksgiving Break remains Wednesday through Friday.
The four-day Labor Day weekend remains in place, with schools closed on both Friday and Monday.

customSections.label: VBCPS Calendar Planning Snapshot
customSections.content: A quick look at scheduled instructional days and extended weekends in the 2026–27 calendar.

definitions.description: The four grading periods contain 47, 43, 46, and 44 scheduled instructional days, respectively, for a total of 180.
The first grading period is the longest at 47 scheduled instructional days; the second is the shortest at 43.

Between the first and last student days, 12 weekdays are scheduled without classes outside Thanksgiving, Winter, and Spring breaks. Three of those dates—November 2, January 25, and April 9—may be used as make-up days if needed.

The published calendar creates three four-day spans without classes: September 4–7, October 31–November 3, and January 23–26. The latter two could be shortened if November 2 or January 25 is used as a make-up day.

customSections.label: What VBCPS Families Should Know
customSections.content: VBCPS lists grading-period dates separately from adjusted-dismissal days. Not every grading-period ending is an early-release day.

definitions.description: They end October 30, January 22, April 8, and June 11. The calendar identifies June 11—not every grading-period ending—as a districtwide adjusted-dismissal day.
High school students have adjusted dismissal June 8–10; all students have adjusted dismissal June 11.
November 2, January 25, and April 9 are the designated options for the first three grading periods. A fourth-grading-period date is designated by the superintendent.
The School Board may revise the calendar during the year, and the superintendent determines student and staff make-up dates after weather or emergency closures.

customSections.label: Moving to VBCPS During the School Year
customSections.content: About 25 percent of VBCPS students are active-duty military dependents. Families moving during the school year can contact the district’s two full-time military school counselors for help with academic transitions and other military-connected student needs.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the first day of school for VBCPS in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: The first student day is Monday, August 24, 2026. The first grading period also begins that day.

calendarFaqs.q: When is VBCPS Winter Break in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break runs Monday, December 21, 2026, through Friday, January 1, 2027. Students return Monday, January 4.

calendarFaqs.q: When is VBCPS Spring Break in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break runs Monday, March 29, through Friday, April 2, 2027. Students return Monday, April 5.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of school for VBCPS?
calendarFaqs.a: The scheduled last student day is Friday, June 11, 2027. It is also the end of the fourth grading period and a districtwide adjusted-dismissal day.

calendarFaqs.q: Are VBCPS students off for Veterans Day?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. VBCPS schools are closed Wednesday, November 11, 2026, for Veterans Day.

calendarFaqs.q: Where can I check for VBCPS calendar changes?
calendarFaqs.a: Check the official VBCPS calendar page and district communications. School Board policy allows calendar revisions during the year, and the superintendent determines make-up days after weather or emergency closures.
